subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should empty `server_error` turns retry before configured model fallback for every harness, or only for the reported embedded/OpenRouter-style clean provider 5xx path?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes provider-failure ordering, but current tests preserve Codex `server_error` handoff to model fallback; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow retry to the reported safe path
options.body: Preserve Codex/configured-fallback server_error handoff while allowing clean embedded provider 5xx turns to use empty-error retry.

options.title: Accept broad retry-before-fallback
options.body: Update the Codex/fallback contract and tests to make empty server_error retry the new universal first recovery step.

options.title: Consolidate in a sibling fix PR
options.body: Pause this branch and move the useful current-attempt metadata pieces into the best open canonical PR for the issue.

recommendation.title: Narrow retry to the reported safe path
recommendation.body: Preserve Codex/configured-fallback server_error handoff while allowing clean embedded provider 5xx turns to use empty-error retry.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and authored adjacent retry/fallback behavior and is the strongest history-backed owner for the server_error fallback boundary.
